description: This file defines the Task class used in the SuiteCRM module, encompassing properties and methods for handling task-related data, including CRUD operations, related data retrieval, formatting, and ACL checks.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: Represents a task entity within SuiteCRM, providing properties for task data fields and methods for managing task lifecycle, related data, display formatting, and access control.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current task record, setting default status if not defined.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns a string summary of the task, typically its name.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Builds an SQL query for exporting task data based on specified conditions and ordering.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates additional related contact details into the task object.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_parent_fields
methods.description: Retrieves and assigns parent entity information based on parent type and ID.

methods.name: formatStartAndDueDates
methods.description: Formats and displays task start and due dates with styling based on status and date comparison.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares task data for list view rendering, formatting dates, status, and related contact/parent info.

methods.name: set_notification_body
methods.description: Assigns task details into an email notification template.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Checks if the bean implements specific interfaces like ACL.

methods.name: listviewACLHelper
methods.description: Determines ACL permissions for list view access to related parent and contact entities.

methods.name: getDefaultStatus
methods.description: Returns the default status value for new task records based on field definitions or options.
